excerpts: App Eraser helps remove unwanted macOS applications and any related files that they leave behind.
App Eraser is a Free and Open Source macOS app removal tool.
Enable Finder access in the Automation section. This allows App Eraser to move files to trash
Enable the folders you want to allow App Eraser to search in Files and Folders
App Eraser gets the name and bundle ID for the app you select to remove
Only files with a score greater than the threshold are deemed to be related to the app

workflow.intent: Review an app-uninstaller's name/bundle-ID matches before deciding what belongs in Trash
workflow.title: Review App Eraser’s related-file matches before removing a Mac app
workflow.description: App Eraser finds related-file candidates by app name and bundle ID. Review those matches, permission limits and shared data before removal; use storage investigation for a different question.
outline: Lead with the distinction between removing an unwanted app and explaining disk growth; official competitor app view immediately after lead when cleared.
Explain filename matching and its uncertainty, with source citations rather than a fabricated scan.
Decision checklist: save work, inspect checked candidates and Finder locations, keep uncertain/shared data, distinguish Trash moves from newly available space. No removal performed by this job.
Explain permission-limited search and unknown modern compatibility without suggesting security bypasses.
Later Space preview with example-data caption: storage investigation is a separate reader job, not proof of uninstall completeness.

One bounded recommendation with 'Breathing Room, which we build'; prefer App Eraser for focused review of app-related files, preview investigation for broader storage questions subject to release caveats.
workflow.interactionPass: Plan a non-executing decision checklist: known app-related item / uncertain or shared item / storage growth unrelated to app removal. No simulated filesystem scan, savings calculator or deletion control.
mustNotClaim: Breathing Room is a full app uninstaller
No data ever leaves either app
workflow.pendingEvidence: Competitor visual clearance and inspection required before drafting; use Apple/vendor documentation before adding general uninstall or Trash semantics as sourced macOS facts.

appEraserAdvantages: Free, focused Mac app-removal offer (AE-01, AE-02).
Inspectable name/bundle-ID discovery plus checked candidate review and Finder reveal (AE-04, AE-05).
appEraserTradeoffs: Matching names does not establish that shared or personal data is disposable; candidates initialize checked (AE-04, AE-05).
Permissions constrain discovery, modern OS minimum/runtime and current signing remain unverified (AE-06, AE-U1, AE-U2).
Published licence declarations disagree, and screenshot reuse is not cleared (AE-09).
breathingRoomAdvantages: Source implements broader storage exploration and grouped process inspection (BR-02); editorial fit for investigating where space goes, not a verified replacement for app uninstalling.
breathingRoomTradeoffs: Preview release caveats, Python prerequisite and lack of notarization; no clean-machine/physical Intel runtime proof (BR-01).
Hosted AI requires authentication/internet and can send relevant investigation data; optional recurring AI Care costs money (BR-02).
Full app-removal completeness and measured savings not established; do not promise them.
